header:
Awesome Finance and Accounting

> Open-source accounting, invoicing, budgeting, personal finance, payments and tax tools for freelancers and small businesses. Every entry shows its license. **Rules of this list:** every repo exists, is public, is not archived, states a license and has had a commit in the last year. One plain sentence each. Star counts and claims are the authors' own, we did not test every tool. Checked 2026-10-18. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md).
footer:
## How to choose

- **Not tax or legal advice.** Check rules in your country or ask an accountant.
- **Self-hosting finance data means you do backups and security.**
- **Check the license and the data format.** You should be able to export everything.
- **Test with fake data first.**

## Contributing

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md). One entry per pull request, plain words, real sources only.
